text:
sam (sales): Pat from BigHealth sent a SIG/CAIQ request and wants artifacts proving SSO + MFA + RBAC. They're asking for: IdP metadata, MFA enforcement policy + consolidated auth logs (90d), role export + examples of least-privilege enforcement. Can we pack this up by tomorrow?

toni (solutions): Yes. I will assemble SP+IdP metadata, a short SSO validation checklist, and role export. Question: do they need SLO/SLO logout flows?

pat@bighealth: Prefer SP-initiated details and SLO if it's part of our standard SAML. Also need confirmation MFA applies to console and admin UI flows.

ravi (security): Confirmed: MFA enforced by policy for all interactive console/admin logins. API keys and service tokens are excluded by design. We'll add the MFA policy excerpt and a high-level diagram of auth flow.

sam (sales): Legal is asking about usernames in the logs. Do we provide plaintext emails or pseudonymous IDs?

ravi (security): Defaults: we can provide logs with obfuscated IPs and pseudonymized IDs (uid: user-XXXX). If BigHealth signs an NDA/addendum we can provide full usernames.

toni (solutions): I'll include RBAC export as JSON + a couple of screenshots of the Roles page. Example role export (will be in packet):

```json
[{
  "role": "platform_admin",
  "permissions": ["deploy:create", "config:write", "users:manage"]
}, {
  "role": "model_ops",
  "permissions": ["deploy:create", "jobs:view", "logs:view"]
}, {
  "role": "engineer",
  "permissions": ["models:invoke", "models:list"]
}]
```

pat@bighealth: Also include your service-account policy. We need evidence that service accounts use short-lived tokens.

ravi (security): Service accounts issued via our STS (default max TTL 24h). Long-lived credentials are rotated every 90 days and tracked in audit. I'll attach the policy snippet and rotation schedule.

toni (solutions): SAML metadata fragment (SP entity) we'll include in packet: 

```xml
<EntityDescriptor entityID="https://redwood-infer.example.com/sp">
  <SPSSODescriptor AuthnRequestsSigned="true" WantAssertionsSigned="true">
    <!-- trimmed for packet -->
  </SPSSODescriptor>
</EntityDescriptor>
```

ravi (security): Sample auth log lines (we'll redact per legal):

```
2026-11-02T08:12:03Z uid:user-72 MFA:ok method:webauthn svc:console
2026-11-15T21:04:11Z uid:user-19 MFA:fail method:totp svc:console
```

sam (sales): I'll draft an email with a preliminary packet (no usernames) so PubHealth can start review. If legal signs off, we swap in full log exports.

upload-bot: uploaded: bighealth-auth-evidence-1826002222.zip -> https://secure-share.company/BigHealth/1826002222 (internal link, expires 7d)

pat@bighealth: Thanks — can you also map the artifacts to SIG controls (e.g., AAC/MFA/RBAC mapping)? That helps our risk team.

ravi (security): Will add a short mapping doc: e.g., CCM_AAC_01 -> SSO enabled (artifact: saml-metadata.xml), CCM_AAC_02 -> MFA enforced (artifact: mfa-policy.pdf + logs), CCM_AAC_03 -> RBAC enforcement (artifact: roles.json + screenshots).

sam (sales): Great. Team: Toni/Ravi assemble final packet by EOD tomorrow. I'll coordinate with Legal if they want usernames. :thumbsup:
